themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across multiple nations are accelerating campaign machinery, convening party congresses, and refining policy platforms ahead of key electoral contests. From high-stakes midterm rallies in the United States to leadership congresses for Lega in Italy and Rassemblement National in France, party figures are mobilizing core bases and setting competitive campaign narratives.

themes.title: Hardline Anti‑Immigration Policies Surge
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements in North America and Northern Europe continue to prioritize border control and scrutinize immigration's societal impact. Recent coverage spans executive enforcement actions in the U.S. aimed at naturalization applicants and border barriers alongside political arguments over immigrant healthcare integration and public costs in Norway.
